layers.description: The USGS Transportation downloadable data from The National Map (TNM) includes railroad features sourced from the Federal Railroad Administration (FRA) National Rail Network. Transportation data consists of active and inactive rail lines, rail yards, and related infrastructure associated with the transport of people or freight. The data include the name, ownership, classification, subdivision, and location of rail features. Railroad data support general mapping and geographic information system technology analysis for applications such as hazardous materials routing, emergency response planning, and infrastructure management.

columns.name: fcode
columns.description: This five-digit code has two parts: the first three digits encode the feature type (FType); the last two digits encode values for a unique set of characteristics associated with the feature type.

columns.name: name
columns.description: The official or common name of the rail line or feature, as attributed by the source dataset. May include the railroad company name or the name of the route.

columns.name: rail_class
columns.description: A classification describing the area served by the rail feature. USGS NGTOC archives' Data Dictionary: Trans_v11.xls, draft copy 2013

columns.name: rail_owner
columns.description: The person(s) or organization(s) that possess the rail line. USGS NGTOC archives' Data Dictionary: Trans_v11.xls, draft copy 2013

columns.name: rail_owner_code
columns.description: The abbreviated code (typically 2-4 characters) identifying the railroad owner, following the Association of American Railroads (AAR) or Surface Transportation Board (STB) reporting mark conventions.

columns.name: rail_subdiv
columns.description: The name of the railroad subdivision, which is an operational segment or district used by the railroad company to organize and manage its network. Subdivisions often reflect historical acquisition or operational boundaries.

columns.name: rail_usage
columns.description: The use(s) to which a railway is put as part of a transportation system. USGS NGTOC archives' Data Dictionary: Trans_v11.xls, draft copy 2013

columns.name: length_km
columns.description: Length of the rail segment in kilometers (km).
